annotation.title_en: National Strategy on Artificial Intelligence - an institutional step in governing new technology
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ (Ministry of Science and Technology, Vietnam)
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Science and Technology web article explaining the National AI Strategy as codified in Vietnam's AI law. It stresses sovereign Vietnamese-language foundation models, national AI infrastructure, talent, public-private partnership, international norm-shaping, and the Ministry's role in publishing a priority AI technology list. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy is enshrined in law as an institutional step
Priority on Vietnamese foundation models and large language models for data sovereignty
Build national AI infrastructure: computing, data centres, open data
Public-private partnership as main mobilisation mechanism
MST publishes and updates the priority AI technology list and guides ministries and localities
